header: The production error log, read from the terminal (src/lib/errorLog/). I use the same database as the application (.env.local). npm run errors the open errors, serious first (new and seen; not the resolved) npm run errors -- all everything, resolved too npm run errors -- serious only the serious ones npm run errors -- show 12 one error in full: message, page, the model's or rule's note, stack npm run errors -- seen 12 you have looked: it is no longer announced again npm run errors -- resolve 12 fixed: it is announced again only if it comes back npm run errors -- digest run the daily digest now (cleans old rows, sends the notice if the address is set)
